orig.il: And it came to pass in the eleventh
unto me: I shall be replenished
and it shall become a spoil
And they shall make a spoil

orig.gloss: and/ they will take as spoil

orig.il: And I will cause the noise

orig.gloss: and/ I will put an end to

orig.il: no more: for I the Lord
to thee, How art thou destroyed

orig.gloss: and/ I will send down/ you
orig.il: When I shall bring thee down

orig.gloss: and/ I will cause to dwell/ you
